integrity: Rigidity via eight forced norming-pair equations and explicit determinant 64 beta^4; the numerical norm calculation supplies supporting input rather than the original contribution.
scientific_limitations: Unique best retraction only for the canonical isometric embedding into real four-coordinate sup space. The numerical projection constant is a known consequence of the planar self-length identity; bibliographic risk remains about broader uniqueness of polygonal minimal projections.
title: Rigidity of all minimum-norm projections onto symmetric octagonal planes
